aim_summary.goal: Add a simple locking mechanism in the hook area to secure the carried load.
preserve_targets: existing hook and all non-targeted model geometry
aim_summary.expected_outcome: A simple locking feature is located at the hook, secures the carried load, and constrains unintended release while preserving the existing load-carrying geometry.

operations_plan.summary: Create a locking feature in section R03 after its unspecified type, profile, placement, interfaces, and dimensions are resolved.

steps.description: Extrude the resolved locking-feature profile in the hook area and integrate it with the applicable geometry.

expected_result.geometry: A simple locking mechanism exists in the area of the open hook throat in R03.
expected_result.function: The locking mechanism secures the carried load at the hook.
expected_result.behavior: The locking mechanism constrains unintended release of the carried load from the hook.

validation_criteria.description: A locking feature is present in the area of the hook.
The locking mechanism secures the carried load at the hook.
The final mechanism constrains unintended release of the carried load from the hook.
The hook retains its load-carrying role, and non-targeted model geometry remains unchanged except where necessary to integrate the locking mechanism.
